business_summary: Zhejiang Fulai New Materials Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of multifunctional coating composite materials in China and internationally. The company operates through five segments: Advertising Inkjet Printing Materials; Label and Marking Printing Materials; Electronic-Grade Functional Materials; Functional Base Film Materials; and Other. It offers self-adhesives PP, cold laminating, and backlit transparency films, as well as PVC, display rack, and water white/water permeable; basic film, digital printing, direct thermal, water-based inkjet, and special solutions; and ultra-thin, PET double-sided, mesh, and UV adhesion reduction tapes, as well as release film and silicone, acrylic, and PU protective films. The company also provides inkjet printing, lamination film decoration, home improvement protection, privacy protection, home decoration, and digital hot stamping; cup paper and lunch box paper, greaseproof paper, heat seal paper, and moisture resistant paper; and flexible sensors and sensing systems, including FOS resistive tactile sensing, FOI industrial inspection, FOH medical health monitoring, and FOB new energy battery monitoring systems. Its products are used in the production of advertising materials in shopping malls, supermarkets, buses, subways, exhibitions, and other places, as well as production of labels and identifications for food and beverages, daily chemical products, medical supplies, cold chain logistics, consumer electronics, automotive electronics, and new energy. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Jiaxing, China.
